scenarios.prompt: A unique-slot bag receives a pickup exactly at capacity, then a duplicate callback. Define stable item identity and an overflow policy without deleting or duplicating items.

criteria.transactions: Pickup/split/merge/move/drop operations preserve stable item/stack identity and totals.
criteria.overflow: Capacity and overflow behavior are explicit and never silently delete excess.
criteria.evidence: Exact-capacity, one-over, duplicate callback and save/reload cases reconcile totals.
